lines.text: The LORD's arm is not too short to save, but the people's iniquities have built barriers between them and God.
No one pleads his case honestly, and the people hatch the eggs of vipers and weave a spider's web.
The people feel their way along the wall, and they growl like lions and moan like doves.
Truth has stumbled in the temple courts, and with no one to intercede, His own arm brought salvation.
The Redeemer will come to Zion, and the LORD promises that His Spirit will not depart from them.
